title: Woolster's Foods
description: A simple Minecraft Mod that adds delicious Burgers to Minecraft
body:
A simple Minecraft mod that adds delicious Foods to Minecraft

Features:
Burgers,
Cheese Burgers,
Cheese,
Milk Cauldron,
Cutting Knife

Future Versions may Include:
Grill,
BBQs,
More Food Items (Pizzas, Ice Creams)
Realistic Cooking Mechanics

Modpack Creators, Yes, you may use this mod in your modpacks
